left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Capacity to ride a bike
  -  Volunteer without a contraindication to moderate physical activity  [OR] or cycling (acute coronary artery disease less than 2 years old, musculoskeletal problem of the spine  [OR] or lower limbs incompatible with cycling)

-  weight < 125 kg
  -  volunteer available for an intervention of 2-3 hours twice a week during 1 month

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Person deprived of liberty  [OR] or legal protection measure
